# Poly Haven assets (CC0)

released under **CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain)**: free for commercial use, no attribution required
(https://polyhaven.com/license). Files are unmodified apart from maps the generator derives next to them
(`*_mask.png`, `*_detail.png`, `*_rgba.png`).
